properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-19 for Mission Bay's block-by-block reconciliation pass, cross-checking OCII's own numbered Land Use Map (Dec 2019) against everything already tracked, as two separate records: 490 Illinois St (UCSF Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision, a 12-story tower with a 5-story south wing and a garden-topped 3-story north wing, ~75,000 sq ft of parking for 200+ vehicles, opened 2020, ~$237M) and 499 Illinois St (Alexandria Center for Science and Technology, a 6-story, ~450,000 sq ft biotechnology building completed 2008, where UCSF leased ~90% of the space for over a decade before purchasing the building outright from Alexandria Real Estate Equities). MERGED 2026-09-22 per the owner's direction: both share the same DataSF Building Footprints mblr (SF3940003) -- one Assessor block-lot pairing, described together as a connected 490-499 Illinois campus in commercial listings -- so tracking them as two separate records double-counted one real estate holding. Combined into one MultiPolygon (the two building footprints remain geometrically distinct pieces, ~12m apart, not touching) under this project's own OCII block number X4. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: several statements above are not supported by their cited sources. (1) OpenStreetMap tags way 84821715 as 499 Illinois Street and way 84821722 as 490 Illinois Street (both building:levels 6, height 28, source Yahoo), the opposite of the assignment in digitized_from; DataSF Parcels list lots 3940003 (409 Illinois St), 3940004 (499) and 3940005 (409-499) under mapblklot 3940003 and none addressed 490 Illinois St, so the shared mblr SF3940003 is a 409/499 Illinois pairing, not a 490/499 one. Which mapped footprint is the 490 Illinois Street Vision Center is unresolved and left to the owner; geometry not changed. (2) No cited source calls 499 Illinois St the 'Alexandria Center for Science and Technology' (removed from project_name), gives ~450,000 sq ft (SGH: a 500,000 sq ft center in two buildings; SF Standard 2025-12-17: 409 and 499 together add up to 470,000 sq ft), or is a commercial listing describing a connected 490-499 campus (none is cited). (3) SF Standard 2025-12-17 says UCSF's clinics, labs and offices leased space at 499 Illinois, where it occupied 90% of the building, and that UCSF bought 409 and 499 Illinois from Alexandria; 'for over a decade' is not in it. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat, notes reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed DataSF Building Footprints outline (mblr SF3940003), names/addresses from OpenStreetMap; not a hand trace or plan estimate. UCSF's own occupancy at 499 Illinois St (leased space and 90% of the building, then bought it with 409 Illinois St from Alexandria in Dec 2025, per SF Standard 2025-12-17) versus outright ownership at 490 Illinois St is not distinguished in this single combined record -- see the digitization_method above for each wing's own history. See the 2026-09-29 accuracy audit entry in digitization_method: which OSM way and footprint is 490 versus 499 Illinois St is unresolved.'; notes: 'OCII plan block X4 (this project's own reconciliation, per docs/briefs/mission_bay_block_inventory.csv, treats X4 as absorbed into this building complex; the Land Use Map's text does not itself say what X4 is). UCSF Health's own location page gives a Reproductive Health clinic at 499 Illinois Street, Floor 6.'. 2026-10-06: accuracy audit (October 2026) correction to the 2026-09-29 entry above: SF Standard (2025-12-17) does say 'For more than a decade, the school's clinics, labs, and administrative offices had leased space at 499 Illinois', so the original 'for over a decade' wording was supported and the 2026-09-29 statement that it is not in the article was wrong. Text-only; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type. 2026-10-10 -- RENAMED from '490/499 Illinois Street (UCSF Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision and 499 Illinois Street)' to '409/499 Illinois Street': the Valley Center for Vision at 490 Illinois St is the block 33 building across Illinois St (ucsf_valley_center_for_vision_west.geojson's 2026-10-10 entry has the evidence), and this shape's two footprints are 409 and 499 Illinois St. Read 2026-10-10 from DataSF Addresses (3mea-di5p): 499 ILLINOIS ST (eas_address_id 680852, point -122.38778544, 37.76598214, parcel 3940001) falls inside the southern footprint and 409 ILLINOIS ST (701368, point -122.38781226, 37.76649526, parcel 3940001) inside the northern one (shapely point-in-polygon); this settles the 2026-09-29 question of which footprint is which, and OSM's 490 label on way 84821722 is wrong. The Vision Center's facts (2017 Regents approval, 2020 opening, $237M cost, SmithGroup, 347,500 sq ft) and the Caffe Central tenant moved to that record. Shape, status, use and geometry_type unchanged. properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 3940003 (15,223 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. The lot is condominium-mapped: 3 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lot 3940003 and 2 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the two surveyed building footprints (DataSF Building Footprints, mblr SF3940003); 98% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 55% of the lot. The lot also takes in the courtyard and yard between the two buildings and a strip of the neighbouring parks P23 and P24; those two park outlines were trimmed back to this lot's edge on the same date, so the records no longer overlap.
